title: sinair-llm-bot-prod
description: Production bot message counts, spending and project resource usage. Message totals cover the last 24 hours. Server-wide information is on Server.

panels.title: Bot status
panels.description: Collector is ready only while its heartbeat is fresh and all configured rooms are joined. Bot mode distinguishes intentional pauses from missing telemetry.

targets.expr: ((1 + (max(bot_state_active_rooms{job="sinair-llm-bot-prod"}) == bool 0)) * max(bot_state_enabled{job="sinair-llm-bot-prod"}) + 3 * (max(bot_state_enabled{job="sinair-llm-bot-prod"}) == bool 0)) and on() (max(time() - bot_metrics_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{job="sinair-llm-bot-prod"}) < 120) and on() (max(up{job="sinair-llm-bot-prod"}) == 1)

panels.title: LLM spend / UTC
panels.description: Dedicated-key OpenRouter usage, not hosting or separately billed services. Calendar day and month are UTC. Values disappear if the last successful poll is over 15 minutes old.

panels.title: Chat messages / last 24h
panels.description: Counts over the last 24 hours of observed traffic, not pending work. Human messages exclude history replays, duplicates, this bot's echoes and sleeping-room messages. Bot replies are collector-acknowledged. Prometheus estimates counter increases between scrapes; missing data is unknown, not zero.

panels.title: Project / current
panels.description: Only sinair-llm-bot-prod containers. CPU is a share of host capacity; RAM is their combined working set.

targets.expr: 100 * sum(max by(name) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{job="cadvisor",image!="",name!="",container_label_com_docker_compose_project="sinair-llm-bot-prod"}[5m]))) / scalar(count(node_cpu_seconds_total{job="node",mode="idle"})) and on() (min(up{job="cadvisor"}) == 1) and on() (min(up{job="node"}) == 1)

panels.title: CPU and RAM
panels.description: Only Sinair production containers. CPU and RAM are shares of total host capacity, not whole-server usage or percentages of container limits.

targets.expr: 100 * sum(max by(name) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{job="cadvisor",image!="",name!="",container_label_com_docker_compose_project="sinair-llm-bot-prod"}[5m]))) / scalar(count(node_cpu_seconds_total{job="node",mode="idle"})) and on() (min(up{job="cadvisor"}) == 1) and on() (min(up{job="node"}) == 1)

100 * sum(max by(name) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{job="cadvisor",image!="",name!="",container_label_com_docker_compose_project="sinair-llm-bot-prod"})) / scalar(sum(node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{job="node"})) and on() (min(up{job="cadvisor"}) == 1) and on() (min(up{job="node"}) == 1)

panels.title: Chat activity
panels.description: Estimated counts in non-overlapping 30-minute windows. Human messages are shown as bars; acknowledged bot replies are shown as a line. The rightmost window and Last values show recent activity. Counts are derived from scraped counters and do not identify individual messages or prove delivery to the chat server.

panels.title: Containers
panels.description: Container: ${container:raw}. RAM used is working set, excluding inactive file cache. RAM limit is a cap, not reserved memory. No cap means no effective cap below host RAM; missing limits are Unknown. RAM % is N/A without a usable limit.

panels.title: Alert history
panels.description: Sampled firing intervals for Sinair bot alerts during the last 24 hours. Red means firing; a gap means resolved or no sample. Hover a segment for its approximate start, end and duration. This history lasts only as long as Prometheus retains the underlying series.

panels.title: Failed bot operations / 24h
panels.description: Reply handling: an error while deciding whether to answer, generating a reply or queuing it. Chat summaries: the LLM produced no conversation summary. These count failed attempts, including retries; intentional silence is not a failure. They do not measure answer quality or confirmed message delivery.

panels.title: Reply time / p95 last 24h
panels.description: Time from receiving the trigger message to collector acknowledgment, including deliberate waiting. p95 estimates a duration within which 95% of measured replies were acknowledged; it is not the average or an exact chat-server delivery time. Interpret it with the sample count.
